text:
marta_cs: Quick heads-up — DeltaCo goes live in ~48h. They asked for a SINGLE SLO acceptance packet that includes: in-scope routes, exact measurement definitions, an evidence bundle template, and two worked credit examples they can paste into procurement. Can we finalize today?

david_sre: I'll take metrics + evidence bundle. In-scope routes we agreed on in SOC: /v1/chat (streaming + non-streaming), /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank. Need to decide measurement window for billing (DeltaCo prefers calendar month). I suggest we publish both: calendar-month for invoice credits, rolling 28-day as a stability view for ops.

marta_cs: fine if we provide both, but legal wants the invoice-facing language to reference only calendar-month.

priya_legal: For MSA blurb: "The Service Level Objectives and credit bands are specified in Exhibit A. Credits, as the sole and exclusive remedy for unavailability, will be applied to the next invoice following the measurement period, excluding scheduled maintenance and Force Majeure. Scheduled maintenance will be posted at least 72 hours in advance." Thoughts?

noah_am: good. DeltaCo asked for deterministic math. Can we show a clear formula and two numeric examples? Procurement hates fuzzy wording.

david_sre: Agreed. Proposed credit bands (calendar-month basis):
```
- uptime >= 99.900% : 0% credit
- 99.700% <= uptime < 99.900% : 5% credit
- 99.400% <= uptime < 99.700% : 12% credit
- uptime < 99.400% : 20% credit (maximum)
```
I'll include two examples in the packet (monthly fee $50k and $3k).

marta_cs: Can you also define exactly what counts toward "uptime"? DeltaCo will want the SQL so they can reproduce the calc.

david_sre: Yes. Short definition: uptime = 1 - (count(failed_in_scope_requests) / count(total_in_scope_requests)) where failed_in_scope_requests = server-side 5xx or 429 or internal timeout (we filter client-cancelled requests). We use only server-side responses with a final status code. Exclude scheduled maintenance windows and any time ranges tagged as "outage-exemption" by oncall.

david_sre: SQL-ish example we will publish (this is the canonical query we run):
```sql
SELECT
  1 - (SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 OR status_code = 429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*)) AS uptime
FROM request_events
WHERE route IN ('/v1/chat', '/v1/embeddings', '/v1/rerank')
  AND timestamp >= '{{period_start}}' AND timestamp < '{{period_end}}'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_windows m
    WHERE request_events.timestamp >= m.start_ts
      AND request_events.timestamp < m.end_ts
      AND m.exempt_from_sla = true
  );
```
We will publish the exact query with parameter names in Exhibit A.

tara_enable: I'll build a one-page customer-facing doc + a 7-10 minute Loom that walks through the dashboard, how to read the graphs, and how to request the evidence bundle. Will include the sample SQL snippet and two numeric examples. ETA: EOD.

noah_am: Examples you should include (I'll paste exact numbers):
```
Example 1 (enterprise): monthly invoice = $50,000; observed uptime = 99.65% (calendar month)
- Shortfall band => 99.400% <= 99.65% < 99.700% => 12% credit
- Credit = $50,000 * 12% = $6,000, applied to next invoice

Example 2 (small account): monthly invoice = $3,000; observed uptime = 99.85%
- Shortfall band => 99.700% <= 99.85% < 99.900% => 5% credit
- Credit = $3,000 * 5% = $150
```
Those match procurement requests.

priya_legal: Add a short clause about telemetry: "Measurements are based on server-side telemetry recorded by Redwood Inference. Client-side request cancellations and partial connections are excluded from measurements unless Redwood determines they resulted from Service faults." Keeps it explicit.

david_sre: Evidence bundle contents (what we'll hand DeltaCo on request):
```
- Aggregated uptime timeseries (UTC) for the measurement window (CSV + PNG)
- Raw request_events export (filtered by route and timeframe) with anonymization applied per data policy
- Latency percentile table (p50, p90, p95, p99) and the SQL used to compute them
- Incident timeline entries for any incidents/maintenance that overlap the window
- Calculation worksheet showing the counts used in uptime formula and the resulting credit percent
```
I'll add retention notes (we keep 90 days of raw logs in the default bundle, longer retention via request).

marta_cs: Ops needs to mark scheduled maintenance so it doesn't count. ops_bot, please confirm upcoming maintenance window and that it's excluded.

ops_bot: Maintenance scheduled: window_id=mw-2026-03-22T04:00Z duration=4h posted=72h in advance. This window is flagged exempt_from_sla=true and will be excluded from SLA calculations.

david_sre: One more technical point: latency SLOs — DeltaCo asked for p95 generation latency targets. I propose we publish p95 target for /v1/chat at < 350ms (end-to-end successful responses), embeddings p95 < 140ms, rerank p95 < 450ms. Those are aggressive but achievable with current Dedicated config.

marta_cs: OK. Put those in the packet and call them "operational targets" (not credits). Only uptime triggers credits.

noah_am: Procurement also asked how long after claim they can expect the credit applied. We should confirm "next invoice after calculation" with a max processing time (30 days).

priya_legal: I'll add: "Credits will be reflected on the next invoice following completion of the measurement and verification process, which shall be completed no later than thirty (30) days after the end of the measurement period."

marta_cs: Action items and owners:
- david_sre: finalize SQL snippets, latency target language, evidence bundle template, and include retention notes. ETA: 4 hours.
- tara_enable: customer one-pager + Loom + two worked examples in shareable PNG. ETA: EOD.
- priya_legal: MSA sentence + Exhibit A wording (maintenance notice, credit cap 20%, processing timeline). ETA: EOD.
- noah_am: confirm DeltaCo acceptance of calendar-month billing for credits and raise any counter-proposals. ETA: 2h.

noah_am: pinging DeltaCo now. Will update thread.

marta_cs: Thanks team — if we hit ETAs I'll assemble the packet and request a 20-30m acceptance call with DeltaCo ops tomorrow. Keep any minor wording edits here. :sparkles:
